project_type: Python FastAPI async backend - Autonomous AI Company Operating System
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), tests in tests/ directory, unittest.mock (AsyncMock/MagicMock), class-based test organization
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3.12 -m pytest tests/ -x -q to ensure all tests pass. 2. Import check: python3.12 -c 'from nexus.realtime import WebSocketManager, EventStream, RealtimeEventBus; from nexus.memory.compaction import SessionCompactor; from nexus.memory.token_counter import TokenCounter'
setup_instructions: pyenv is available with Python 3.12.13. Run: python3.12 -m pip install -e '.[dev]' from the project root.
environment_constraints: Python 3.9 is system default but 3.12 available via pyenv. Use python3.12 explicitly. No external services (PostgreSQL, Redis) available - tests must be fully in-memory. No new dependencies allowed per requirements.
contribution_requirements: No new dependencies. No frontend changes. Maintain backward compatibility. Follow existing patterns: docstrings on all classes/functions, type hints, async-first design, UUID-based IDs, company_id scoping for multi-tenancy.
key_patterns: Routes use APIRouter with tags, Pydantic models for request/response, Annotated dependencies (DbSession, CurrentCompanyId from nexus.api.deps). Modules have __init__.py with __all__ exports. Tests use @pytest.mark.asyncio, fixtures in conftest.py, class-based test grouping. Existing event_bus.py in communication/ uses in-memory handler registry with async/sync dispatch. Memory subsystem uses dataclasses with datetime/UUID fields.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ is root package. Subsystems: api/routes/ (27 routers), communication/ (a2a, channels, event_bus, group, hive_*, webhook_*), memory/ (store, layered, dedup, extract, promotion, retriever, scoping, semantic, reflector), plus adapters/, evolution/, governance/, runtime/, etc. Tests in flat tests/ directory with test_*.py files.
